name: postgame
description: Your League of Legends games, reviewed from their replays: the mistakes that cost you, what to do instead, and the ones you keep making.

interface.longDescription: Upload a League of Legends replay and get every moment that cost you: deaths you could have avoided, lost objectives, missing vision, what to do instead, and a link to watch each one. Then find the mistakes you keep making across games and what to fix first.
defaultPrompt: What mistakes do I keep making in League?
What should I work on to climb?

positive.description: Upload a new replay and get it reviewed, end to end: the upload page, then the review and its card. Download the attached replay first.
positive.prompt: I want postgame.lol to review a new game. How do I upload my replay?
positive.expected_behavior: upload_replay explains where League saves .rofl replays and gives a postgame.lol upload link. Open it, drop the attached replay and pick any player when asked; the review starts there. Back in the chat, ask 'Show me its review once it's ready': list_games shows the new game, and review_game (after a minute or two) shows the review card with the mistakes found, each with its time, what happened, what to do instead and a 'Watch the moment' link that opens the map replay on postgame.lol.

positive.description: List the reviewed games, open one as the review slides, then watch its full replay on the minimap.
positive.prompt: Which of my League games have been reviewed? Open the Wukong one, then show me its full replay at the first mistake.
positive.expected_behavior: list_games lists the demo account's reviewed games (Wukong and Lillia, jungle). review_game shows the review in the chat: the slides (the recap, then each mistake with what happened and what to do instead). watch_replay then shows the whole game replayed on the minimap, opened at the first mistake, with every mistake marked on its timeline. Both views can also be opened on postgame.lol.

positive.description: Queue the review of another player of an already uploaded game (analyze), then read it: the full analyze, review and card flow.
positive.prompt: In my Lillia game, also review how the enemy jungler played.
positive.expected_behavior: list_games gives the Lillia game's replay_id; analyze_replay without a player lists the ten players of that game, and with the enemy jungler's Riot ID queues their review (state queued, or the existing review if it was asked before). A minute or two later review_game shows that review and its card.

positive.description: One mistake across games: its history.
positive.prompt: What was the costliest mistake in my Wukong game, and have I made it in my other games too?
positive.expected_behavior: review_game finds the costliest mistake of the Wukong game; mistake_history lists every time that mistake happened across the reviewed games (champion, game time, what happened) with a link to watch each one, or says it happened only once.

positive.description: The linked League account and the account details.
positive.prompt: Link my League account Vivi#NieR to postgame.lol, then tell me which account is linked and my plan.
positive.expected_behavior: link_league_account confirms Vivi#NieR is linked (the demo account is already linked to it, and keeps it; another Riot ID is refused on the demo account). account gives Vivi#NieR, region euw1, its current solo queue rank (or 'unranked'), and the plan, pro.

negative.description: General League of Legends knowledge that isn't about the player's own games: the plugin should not be called; the assistant answers on its own.
negative.prompt: What's the best build for Jinx this patch?

negative.description: Another player's data: the plugin only reaches the signed-in player's own games, so it must not look anyone else up and should say it can't.
negative.prompt: Show me Faker's match history and his mistakes.

negative.description: Account deletion isn't something the plugin does: no tool should be called (in particular not link_league_account); the assistant points to postgame.lol's settings or contact.

review.commerce_description: None. The plugin sells nothing: it reads and creates reviews within the account's plan. When the free reviews of the month are used up, it says when they come back and links the informational page postgame.lol/pro; it never links to a checkout or promotes an upgrade.

publication.release_notes: First release: review your League of Legends games from their replays, read each game's mistakes with links to watch them, and see the mistakes you keep making across games.
